tagline: A quiet forest shrine next to Tokyo's loudest youth fashion
history: Harajuku sits beside Meiji Jingū, a shrine built in 1920 for Emperor Meiji and Empress Shōken. Its forest was planted with about 100,000 trees donated from all over Japan, and has grown into a deep woodland in the middle of the city. After World War II, US military housing and later the 1964 Olympic Village stood nearby, and the area slowly became a center of youth culture. Today narrow Takeshita Street is famous for colorful fashion, crêpes and street style.

sites.name: Meiji Jingū
sites.jp: 明治神宮[めいじじんぐう]
sites.desc: A Shinto shrine for Emperor Meiji and Empress Shōken, reached through tall wooden torii and a man-made forest. Its buildings were destroyed in 1945 and rebuilt after the war.

sites.name: Takeshita Street
sites.jp: 竹下通[たけしたどお]り
sites.desc: A narrow, crowded street of fashion shops, sweets and crêpe stands. It is a symbol of Harajuku's kawaii street style.

sites.name: Yoyogi Park
sites.jp: 代々木公園[よよぎこうえん]
sites.desc: A big park next to Meiji Jingū, on land once used for the 1964 Tokyo Olympic Village. People come to picnic, play music and dance.

facts: Meiji Jingū's forest was planted with about 100,000 trees given by people from all over Japan.
At New Year, Meiji Jingū usually draws more visitors than any other shrine in Japan.
Harajuku Station's old wooden building from 1924 was replaced by a new station in 2020.

reading.title: 原宿[はらじゅく]のクレープ
reading.text:
アンナさんとケンさんは原宿[はらじゅく]へ行[い]きました。朝[あさ]、明治神宮[めいじじんぐう]の鳥居[とりい]を見[み]ました。それから、竹下通[たけしたどお]りでクレープを買[か]いました。
店[みせ]の人[ひと]「いらっしゃいませ。」
アンナ「このクレープはいくらですか。」
店[みせ]の人[ひと]「六百円[ろっぴゃくえん]です。」
アンナ「じゃ、二[ふた]つください。」
店[みせ]の人[ひと]「全部[ぜんぶ]で千二百円[せんにひゃくえん]です。」
reading.en:
Anna and Ken went to Harajuku. In the morning they saw the torii of Meiji Jingū. After that, they bought crêpes on Takeshita Street.
Shop clerk: "Welcome!"
Anna: "How much is this crêpe?"
Shop clerk: "It's 600 yen."
Anna: "Then two, please."
Shop clerk: "That's 1,200 yen in total."

questions.q: Where did they go in the morning?
How much does Anna pay in total?
